# Ecoleaf Development Corporation (ELDC)

> Ecoleaf Development Corporation is a PCAB-licensed general contractor in the Philippines, founded in 2012 and based in Taguig City, Metro Manila. Tagline: "Where construction meets excellence."

## Key facts
- Also known as: ELDC, Ecoleaf, Ecoleaf Development Corp., Ecoleaf Devt. Corp., Ecoleaf Corp.
- Official website: https://ecoleafdevelopment.com
- Services: roads and bridges, site development, mid-rise and high-rise buildings, resorts, warehouses, civil and structural works, design and build, interior fit-out, wastewater treatment plants, power substations.
- Licenses: PCAB licensed; SEC registered.
- Team: more than 100 team members. Total turnover to date: over PHP 850 million.
- Leadership: Chairman Engr. Edgardo Laborte; President Albert Osmon Sia Laborte.
- Service area: Philippines-wide, from Luzon to Mindanao.
- Clients include Wilcon Depot, Megaworld, Meralco, Rockwell Land, Arthaland, Philippine National Bank, Ateneo de Manila University, Anya Resort Tagaytay, Century Park Hotel and The Manila Southwoods Golf & Country Club.
- Office: 2F Gate Panama Bldg., 117 Kalayaan Ave., Taguig City, Metro Manila, Philippines.
- Contact: +63 917 155 2264 (call, text, Viber), (02) 8559 5836, info.eldc@ecoleafdevtcorp.com.
